survey: A three-branch gold candelabra seen from the front, slightly from above. A round domed foot with a stepped rim sits flat on the implied ground. A turned stem rises from the foot, with a baluster knop low down and a collar at mid height. Two U-shaped arms come out of either side of that collar and curve up to drip-pan cups at the same height. The center stem carries on up to its own higher cup. Each cup holds an upright white pillar candle, seated in the cup, each with a wick and a normal flame. The two side branches mirror each other closely. The right candle is a little longer and its cup sits a little lower, which reads as perspective or normal variation between candles. Every part joins the next with no gaps, overlaps or floating pieces. The object would stand on its base and could hold lit candles.
